name: fable-orchestrator
description: Token-frugal multi-agent orchestration for Claude Code: chair profiles for a Fable or an Opus chair with tier routing (Sonnet carries the volume, Opus the hard slices, Fable the hardest plans and highest-stakes checks), workers routed by tier rather than by a per-spawn effort dial, a Requirements Ledger, guard hooks that enforce the discipline, and automatic teammate reaping.
